🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL: Mixed risk and cycle signals despite broad participation. Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive; stocks versus bonds is ↑ rising, RECOVERY (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.75%), while the cyclical-versus-defensive ratio is ↓ falling, BELOW TREND (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -0.17%).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is ↓ falling: VXX (1W: -14.67% | 1M: +9.66%) in CORRECTION; credit stress is easing as HYG/LQD is ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +0.81%). Stocks are beating bonds short term, but the SPY/TLT ratio is in RECOVERY (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.75%), keeping signals mixed.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar strength is ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +2.01%); the yield-curve indicator is ↓ falling, BELOW TREND (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -0.50%). Duration preference is also ↓ falling, BELOW TREND (1W: -1.25% | 1M: -0.34%).

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Financials and defensives show monthly strength: XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%) and XLP (1W: +2.52% | 1M: +6.54%) are ABOVE TREND. Tech is rebounding but remains weaker over the month: XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%) is in RECOVERY; style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US equities are in RECOVERY: SPY (1W: +2.59% | 1M: -2.26%); emerging markets are also in RECOVERY: EEM (1W: +2.68% | 1M: -4.75%). China remains BELOW TREND: FXI (1W: -4.21% | 1M: -2.28%), while India is ABOVE TREND: INDA (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +7.30%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Small caps remain ABOVE TREND: IWM (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +0.89%). Speculation is weak: ARKK (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -12.49%) and IBIT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -16.42%) are BELOW TREND.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Metals are weak: CPER (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -7.40%), GLD (1W: -4.58% | 1M: -7.12%), and SLV (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -15.00%) are BELOW TREND. Natural gas is rebounding: UNG (1W: +8.56% | 1M: -8.48%) is in RECOVERY.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is rebounding: XLE (1W: +5.42% | 1M: -2.40%) is in RECOVERY. Oil remains weak: BNO (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -5.86%) is BELOW TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Broad participation is confirmed by 11/11 sectors positive, while XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%) is ABOVE TREND. Divergence remains in SPY (1W: +2.59% | 1M: -2.26%) and XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%), both in RECOVERY; VXX (1W: -14.67% | 1M: +9.66%) is in CORRECTION.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Maintain a selective, balanced stance given the NEUTRAL regime and broad but uneven signals. XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%) shows strength; reduce exposure to persistent monthly weakness in XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%) and ARKK (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -12.49%).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If broad participation holds and monthly momentum improves, favor financials such as XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%), currently ABOVE TREND.
BEARISH: If tech’s monthly weakness persists, monitor XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%), currently in RECOVERY, for renewed downside.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If the rebound extends, monitor UNG (1W: +8.56% | 1M: -8.48%), currently in RECOVERY.
BEARISH: If weakness continues, monitor silver via SLV (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -15.00%), currently BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Monitor HYG/LQD at 0.7484, ↑ rising and ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +0.81%), and SPY/TLT at 9.5033, ↑ rising and in RECOVERY (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.75%). The cyclical-versus-defensive ratio is 0.6353, ↓ falling and BELOW TREND (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -0.17%).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive. Financials and defensives show relative strength, while style leadership remains mixed. Monitor the recovery-versus-monthly weakness divergence in SPY and XLK.
